blockchain.excerpt: Quantum computers can’t break Bitcoin network’s security yet, but Leo Fan warns that upgrading it and moving funds could take longer than expected.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin briefly drops to $17K on Kraken, exchange upholds trades
blockchain.excerpt: Kraken said all orders were processed correctly and found no evidence of a security breach or compromised accounts.

blockchain.title: South Korean exchanges halt CYBER transfers amid suspected bridge exploit
blockchain.excerpt: Cyber reported unexpected minting of CYBER tokens on Solana, followed by tokens moving out of its Ethereum bridge lockbox, prompting an investigation.

blockchain.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
blockchain.excerpt: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.

blockchain.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
blockchain.excerpt: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

defi.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
defi.excerpt: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

defi.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

defi.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
defi.excerpt: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

defi.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
defi.excerpt: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

defi.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
